identity.name: The Imperial Gambit
identity.aesthetic: Traditional Chinese Luxury x Modern E-Sports
identity.core_metaphor: A high-stakes match in a forbidden palace at night.
principles: Wood over Concrete: No gray backgrounds. Use warm dark browns.
Ink over Shadows: Use deep black gradients instead of generic drop shadows.
Gold over Blue: Primary actions are Gold or Vermilion, never SaaS Blue.
Texture over Flatness: Use grain and paper textures to kill the digital sheen.

heading.usage: All Headings (h1-h3), Hero Text, Modal Titles

accent.usage: Special decorative characters, Rank titles (King, Pawn)

layout_strategy.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A for Lobby, Mode B for Game Board)
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous (p-8 to p-12) to mimic the emptiness of a Zen garden.
layout_strategy.container_style: Glassmorphism but with Wood Texture instead of Blur. Use low opacity black overlay on wood texture.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-red-700 to-red-900 text-white border border-red-500 hover:scale-105 transition-transform font-serif tracking-widest uppercase
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#d4af37] text-[#d4af37] hover:bg-[#d4af37] hover:text-black transition-colors font-serif tracking-widest uppercase

cards.decoration: Add a subtle corner ornament (SVG) in gold to the top-right of cards.

inputs.style: bg-[#1a1614] border-b-2 border-[#4a3b32] focus:border-[#d4af37] outline-none px-4 py-3 text-[#e6dcc3] placeholder:text-[#5c4d45]

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to /app/frontend/src/index.css immediately.
2. OVERRIDE COLORS: Replace the CSS variables in /app/frontend/src/index.css with the palette provided above. DELETE the old zinc/slate colors.
3. TEXTURE IMPLEMENTATION: Create a utility class '.bg-wood' that applies the wood texture with a dark overlay.
4. SHADCN CUSTOMIZATION: When using Shadcn components (Dialog, Popover, Card), manually override their classes to remove 'bg-background' and add 'bg-[#241e1b] border-[#4a3b32]'.
5. BOARD DESIGN: The Xiangqi board must be the centerpiece. Use the wood texture. The grid lines should be black with 0.6 opacity.
6. PIECES: Use CSS circles with the 'Ma Shan Zheng' font for the characters on the pieces. Red pieces: White bg, Red text, Red border. Black pieces: Wood bg, Black text, Black border.
7. LANGUAGE: The interface is Vietnamese. Ensure all static text is in Vietnamese (e.g., 'Chơi Ngay', 'Cửa Hàng', 'Xếp Hạng').
8. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, piece cells).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very large hero title.
Avoid 'SaaS Blue' (#3b82f6) entirely. It breaks the immersion.
Use 'sonner' for toasts, styled with the gold/black theme.
Ensure high contrast for accessibility, even in this dark theme.
Animations should be slow and ease-out (duration-500 or duration-700).
